versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Salmon earn Stamps by surviving attacks; a full passport in the front row sends a fish home to fire its Spawn, hand its stats to its neighbours and leave a Fry that grows back.
Play it as a spawning cycle that pumps stats into a carry, or hoard Stamps in the back row and cash them in as Attack and buffs.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Each slot now comes home at most once a turn, a hatched Fry starts with no Stamps, and only coming home counts as spawning, so homecoming chains can't loop forever.
Rust-Flank Hen and Old Bradán read clearly, the Reunion Secretary is one simple line, the Fry gets Shield, and the Seal-Scarred Veteran stamps back-row fish.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
